newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Soros raises stake in Israel's El-Rov to 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Soros raises stake in Israel's El-Rov to 23 pct.

text.p: A group of funds owned by U.S. investor George Soros has bought an additional 7.12 percent of El-Rov (Israel) Ltd, raising its stake to 23.12 percent, El-Rov said on Wednesday.

Two funds controlled by Soros, Emerging Dolphin and Quantum Emerging Growth Partners CV, acquired 889,840 shares from a subsidiary company of El-Rov at 30.70 shekels each for a total of 27.3 million shekels, the property development and management concern said.

Both funds became major shareholders under Israeli regulations last December when their individual holdings began to exceed five percent. Soros is the second-largest shareholder in El-Rov after Israeli businessman Alfred Akirov, who holds 64.8 percent of the shares.
El-Rov said the investment was made after an examination of the Israeli real estate market indicated El-Rov had good chances of growth with high profits.
El-Rov said the George Soros group expressed its intention to increase its involvement in the company and work to raise funds for it in the United States by issuing El-Rov shares there.
The two Soros funds also hold 1.3 percent in Elkanit Development Ltd, a subsidiary of El-Rov.

El-Rov said its total holdings today are worth 750 million shekels and it collects 15 million shekels in annual rent. It plans to invest 300 million shekels in the completion of its projects in the next three years.
